answer.rationale: Primary region write-path latency is isolated and severe (5x target) with no rollback option due to compliance-mandated security patch. Memory_b2 confirms regional failover previously resolved similar latency degradation by cleanly shifting traffic and restoring error rates within minutes. This directly preserves write availability during peak settlement. Alternatives are invalidated: rollback is blocked, capacity addition may not address root cause fast enough, circuit breakers target dependencies (not regional infrastructure), and read-replica routing does not affect write latency.
